nodes.name: Authenticated DNS Observation Ingress
nodes.notes: Uses existing Header Auth credential metadata. No credential values are present in this export.

nodes.name: Correlate Current Observation
nodes.notes: Compact current-observation correlation. Schema 2 retains bounded closed episodes for reports; Midway-only and internal-observer-stale conditions remain diagnostic/reporting evidence, not alert triggers.

nodes.name: Respond Observation Accepted or Rejected
nodes.notes: Returns 400 for malformed observations and 202 after correlation state is committed; promotion is intentionally asynchronous.

nodes.name: Expand Actionable Transition Events
nodes.notes: Midway-only diagnostic transitions never appear in this queue.

nodes.name: Send Actionable Transition to Operational Event Ingress
nodes.notes: Only actionable opened/recovered canonical conditions are sent. Uses existing Header Auth credential metadata; no secret is exported.

nodes.name: Record Ingress Promotion Failure
nodes.notes: Failure is retained as bounded audit metadata after the caller already received its accepted/rejected response.

nodes.name: Daily DNS Report Schedule
nodes.notes: Runs once daily at 09:00 America/New_York and reports the preceding local calendar day.

nodes.name: Manual DNS Report Proof
nodes.notes: Operator-only proof trigger; it builds the same previous-local-day report as the schedule.

nodes.name: Build DNS Operational Report
nodes.notes: Builds daily, weekly, or monthly reports from the same bounded correlated episode state; no observer or raw telemetry is added.

nodes.name: Send DNS Report to Leto Reports
nodes.notes: Uses one restrained cadence color and the existing #leto-reports credential; no alert credential is used.

nodes.name: Weekly DNS Report Schedule
nodes.notes: Runs Monday at 09:10 America/New_York for the preceding Monday–Sunday week.

nodes.name: Monthly DNS Report Schedule
nodes.notes: Runs on the first of each month at 09:20 America/New_York for the preceding calendar month.

main.node: Send Actionable Transition to Operational Event Ingress
Send DNS Report to Leto Reports
